name: Hitachi Energy India Ltd.
about: Hitachi Energy India Limited offers products, projects, and services for electricity transmission and related activities in India and internationally. The company is involved in engineering, integration, installation, commissioning, and support of project and services, and design, manufacturing, configuration, and supply of system, equipment, devices, and accessories products. It also manufactures and sells electric motors, generators, transformers, and electricity distribution and control apparatus, as well as projects and services related electrical equipment. verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~42% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~25% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 11.7% cost of equity).
PE of 115 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 250), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 115 vs sector median 46; peers with similar ROCE and growth trade nearer 44, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
Since 2023, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 108% a year while PE moved 186 → 115.
